verdict.rationale: Numeral is a sales-tax calculation and compliance API/SaaS, not an agent or agent host, so consuming external MCP servers' tools is outside its product role. The evidence shows only the opposite role: Numeral publishes its own MCP server for external MCP clients (Claude, Cursor) to connect to. That server-side evidence does not transfer to this MCP-client story, and nothing shows Numeral itself connecting to or calling third-party MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
